entities.summary: The final book of the Bible, a vision received by John on the island of Patmos (c. 95 CE). Features apocalyptic imagery: seven seals, trumpets, and bowls of judgment; the beast and the dragon; the fall of Babylon; and the New Jerusalem descending from heaven. Concludes the biblical canon with the promise of Christ's return.
